name: Torch of Retribution
summary: The Torch of Retribution is used to set the Dark Iron watchtowers in Searing Gorge ablaze. Its fire keeps guards from occupying the towers for a long time.

sections.title: Fire in the Towers
sections.body: The four Sentry Towers in Searing Gorge still stand, but the Torch of Retribution can set each one alight for a very long time. No element or force can quench its fire. While the towers burn, Dark Iron guards cannot hold those watch posts, leaving their first line of defense undone.

faq.q: What does the Torch of Retribution do?
faq.answer: The Torch of Retribution sets the four Sentry Towers in Searing Gorge ablaze. Its fire lasts a very long time and cannot be subdued.

faq.q: Where do I use the Torch of Retribution?
faq.answer: You use the Torch of Retribution inside the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers in Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Why set the towers on fire?
faq.answer: The fire keeps guards and sentries from occupying the towers, nullifying the Dark Irons' first line of defense.

faq.q: Can the Torch of Retribution destroy the towers?
faq.answer: No. The four towers cannot be destroyed, but the Torch of Retribution can keep them burning for a very long time.
